descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92592 AC 2, 3, 7, 8; UAT TC-22 ER · “Conditional orders ... and monitoring-phrased physician orders are extracted as tasks; retractions ("leave glargine at 20") are not”.

Bug N20 · S1 · new

Save & Extract closes the wrong tasks and misses ordinary-word results: 'blood cultures still pending' closes 'Follow up blood cultures'; 'urinalysis came back negative', 'INR came back 2.4', Mg / culture / chemistry / vitamin D results leave their tasks open

Tickets: TFA-92592 AC 2 · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: Dev: TC-22 3.2 check 1 of 10 (needs 9 of 10; TC-22/S04 Hospital 0/5, S05 Nursing Home 1/5). AI-judged content; merged without a person's check (Quinn 2026-10-20).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-22/S04, TC-22/S05

Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S05 Save & Extract outcome table on the live model: matched, unmatched, still pending, restated, conditional, monitoring, retraction, given medication, bedside check, action item

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing, once and with no duplicates, leaves unmatched tasks open, and records the dictated medication events. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 2; TFA-92592 rule 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T1 Save & Extract extracts conditional orders ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') and monitoring-phrased physician orders as tasks; retractions ('leave glargine at 20') are not. (TFA-92592 AC 3; UAT TC-22) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 A medication already given ('restarted metoprolol this morning') is documented as performed, not re-ordered. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U7 Bedside checks stay reminders, not findings: 'check for dysuria' never becomes 'reports dysuria'. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Each mode's fixture patient has five open tasks and two tracker rows (seed below)

When Type the dictation into the encounter box and press Save & Extract, once per mode

Then C1 'BMP came back' closes 'Follow up BMP' once. C2 'PT saw her' closes 'PT eval' once. C3 'Wound care consult' (not mentioned) stays open. C4 the conditional diet order becomes one new task. C5 'leave glargine at 20' adds no task and leaves the glargine row unchanged. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Backend probe after each checkpoint (rounding:get / snf:get): BMP and PT eval done; Wound care consult, Follow up blood cultures and Recheck weight in two weeks open; exactly one new task matching each of 'clears', 'potassium' and 'urine culture'; countMatching('weight') = 1; no task matching 'glargine' or 'metoprolol'; glargine row unchanged; …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.
